Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val url = "https://example.com"
    val result = Crawlberg.interact(engine, url, listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"selector\":\"#open\",\"type\":\"click\"}", PageAction::class.java), mapper.readValue("{\"selector\":\"#field\",\"text\":\"test_data\",\"type\":\"type\"}", PageAction::class.java), mapper.readValue("{\"selector\":\"#submit\",\"type\":\"click\"}", PageAction::class.java)))
    println(result.actionResults.first().actionIndex)
    println(result.actionResults.first().actionType)
    println(result.actionResults.first().success)
    println(result.actionResults.get(1).actionIndex)
    println(result.actionResults.get(1).actionType)
    println(result.actionResults.get(1).success)
    println(result.actionResults.get(2).actionIndex)
    println(result.actionResults.get(2).actionType)
    println(result.actionResults.get(2).success)
}
```
